datePolicy: Original source register records 2026-11-06 access dates; no external lookup or refresh during drafting. Localization is not a source-access claim. Search-index-only evidence retains its original limits.
uncertainties: Peony/Orchid tariffs do not establish April inventory. Conflicting tax wording and stale shuttle policies require a final written total; twin and cancellation terms unresolved.
Paradise Sails agency tariff covers 2026 only; operator/agency packages must not be merged. No independent hotel or boat safety/quality inspection.
Hotel generic tariffs are not April quotes. Stella tax/service and breakfast inclusion unresolved; Dragon plus-charge calculation, storage and split-stay totals need confirmation.
All food prices, Ninh Binh package, fixed FX and most journey times are estimates. Bus fare is original airport-domain search-index evidence, not a counter check.
Australian visa/passport rules are dated; digital arrival form is not claimed mandatory for Hanoi. Processing time and admission not guaranteed.

Weather/port restrictions can change or cancel sailing; charges for consumed services mean no automatic full refund. General and cruise-fee buffers separate. No bookings, payments, applications or supplier contact.
editingContract: Complete bilingual prose with numeric/date/external-URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell parity. Local drafts only; no Review or stars.

audience.en: Two friends from Sydney travelling on ordinary Australian passports, planning five days around Hanoi and Ha Long Bay, with bay routes, transfers, budget and visa checks.
audience.zh: 两位从悉尼出发、持澳大利亚普通护照的朋友，规划河内和下龙湾五天行程，内容包括海湾路线、交通接驳、预算和签证核对。
